title: 🏍️ What if you could experience MotoGP from the rider's cockpit? 🔥
author: mynamesoe
selftext:
Meet **VORTEX GP** – an indie multiplayer motorcycle racing game! 🏁

Experience first-person motorcycle racing, compete against other players, climb the rankings, upgrade your bike, and become a racing legend!

🔥 Multiplayer Racing

🏆 Competitive Rankings

🏍️ Motorcycle Customization

⚡ Intense Racing Experience

Developed by an indie game developer from Indonesia 🇮🇩

🎮 Coming to the track? Join the race!

Download / Try VORTEX GP on Google Play: 

https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.soenic.vortexgp

\#VORTEXGP #MotorcycleRacing #IndieGame #AndroidGaming #MobileGaming #RacingGame #IndieDev #MotoRacing #SOENICSTUDIO
